title: Fix three lighting bugs
author: claude
summary: A review caught three mistakes in the first version before it was run.
what: A review of the first version caught three mistakes before it was run, and we fixed them.
why: Each of the three would have made the evening room light up wrongly.
how: The directions were checked with a headless test script.
wrong:
- The cove lights pointed the wrong way.
- The length and width of the strip lights were swapped.
- The wrong colour socket was picked on the Mix nodes, because two sockets share the same name.
fix:
- Aim the cove lights the other way (`aim(d)` instead of `aim(-d)`).
- Use the strip's length as the light's size.
- Pick the Mix node's colour socket by its type (`RGBA`), not by its name.
